split-card-offices.looks: Two columns: a large statement in big type on the left; on the right a contact card with an icon, a heading, up to two icon-and-text detail lines and up to two buttons.
split-card-offices.use: One office's or team's contact details with a short statement.
split-card-offices.avoid: Several offices: use Img Btn 1-3 Col Card (regional-offices) or Icon Hyperlink 1x3 Col Card (connect-grid).

fields.feature1Heading: The card heading, e.g. 'NCMEC Texas Regional Office'.
fields.feature1Icon: Optional 48px icon above the card heading.
fields.feature2Text: A detail line, e.g. the street address.
fields.feature3Text: Another detail, e.g. the phone number.
